Original PCB at rotation 90 deg has pad 1 at (+1,+0.98) mm and pad 2 at (+1,-0.98) mm from center; preserve this footprint geometry, do not replace it with a normally numbered SOT-23 footprint.

Table 7, 5 V version: regulation input range 6.5 to 15 V; output up to 800 mA subject to thermal limits.
Device input operating range 2.5 to 6 V, 150 mA; 3.3 V regulation also requires dropout headroom.
Device input operating range 1.5 to 5.5 V, 500 mA; 3.3 V regulation also requires dropout headroom.
Page 1: repetitive peak current 3 A at duty 0.11; reverse rating VRRM 10 V. This is not a 3 A continuous rating.
General operating conditions: VDD 2.0 to 3.6 V; peripheral-specific constraints are separate.
Page 2 EXS00A-CG04874 row: +/-20 ppm at 25 C. Temperature stability +/-50 ppm is a different parameter.
TBM01-150600456 FCM1608KF-601T05 row: 600 ohm at 100 MHz/60 mV, DCR max 0.50 ohm, rated current 500 mA. Corrects official BOM 350 mA.
Page 1 silver contacts: 32 VDC, 1 to 50 mA, 1 VA max; normally-open momentary. KSS221G is named by original SchDoc; LFS is ordering completion.
Page 3: absolute maximum 25 mA forward, 5 V reverse at 25 C; page 2 dimensions 0603 1.6 x 0.8 mm.
Absolute maximum table: 25 mA forward, 5 V reverse at 25 C; outline 0603 1.6 x 0.8 mm.
Pages 2-5: HSMF-A201 uses GaP red/yellow-green, 30 mA per die and 5 V reverse at 25 C; PLCC-4 pin definitions and 3.5 x 2.8 mm outline.
Page 1: NPN, VCEO 20 V, IC 500 mA, 225 mW on specified FR-5 board at 25 C. Vendor pins B1/E2/C3; original MB1180 footprint uses E1/B2/C3 at corresponding positions.
Pages 1-2: 15-way single-row 2.54 mm pitch, 0.64 mm square posts, 6 mm mating length and 3 mm solder tail, rated 3 A/250 VAC.
Pages 1-2: 5-way single-row 2.54 mm pitch, 0.64 mm square posts, 3 A/250 VAC; stays DNP.
Page 1: 20 pF +/-5%, 50 VDC, NP0, nonpolar, 0603 1.6 x 0.8 mm; stays DNP.

General operating conditions: VDD 1.71 to 3.6 V.

selection_scope: Project procurement variant with original connectivity, pad geometry/names and assembly states preserved; no claim these substitutions are factory-fitted. Allegro package geometry must match the original MB1180 footprints, especially the non-JEDEC SOT23-3 numbering.
